name: @javis-dog/collector-claude-code
description: Claude Code collector. S3c: `javi` CLI (init, hook, flush, status, uninstall), exec-form async command hooks, allowlist mapping to JGR L0 with salted session/agent refs, persistent per-thread sequences, file spool with detached delivery (ADR-0010). S3e: token/cost usage from Claude Code OTel metrics via a local OTLP receiver (ADR-0011). S3f: self-contained bundle + tarball (`npx ./javis-dog-javi-<version>.tgz`), stable copy under ~/.javi/bin. S5b: `--platform gemini-cli` (ADR-0016) — Gemini CLI hooks in the project's .gemini/settings.json, opt-in user-level Gemini telemetry to the same receiver (logs/traces drained unread), Gemini token usage with estimated cost via JD-C02. S5c: `--platform codex-cli` (ADR-0016 Changes S5c) — stable launcher ~/.javi/bin/javi-hook, append-only groups in the project's .codex/hooks.json (approval left to Codex), logs-only [otel] block in $CODEX_HOME/config.toml, receiver path /v1/logs/codex-cli (tokens, API-key cost, sub-agents attributed to their parent), proxy and header guards. S5d: agent self-report (ADR-0017) — post-tool hooks of all three platforms record javi's own `report_status` / `report_task` calls as one JD-C02 self-report record (pre-tool silent, invalid input dropped, prompt flush for non-working statuses, self-reported task.failed and the end-of-turn idle); `javi mcp` serves JD-C03 on stdio; `init --self-report [--allow-self-report] [--allow-tracked-config]` registers `mcpServers.javi` in .mcp.json / .gemini/settings.json or a marked `[mcp_servers.javi]` block in the project .codex/config.toml through the unversioned launcher ~/.javi/bin/javi-mcp.mjs (git-tracked and unparsable files refused); uninstall removes the entry first; status reports registration, pre-approval and a missing Node path. S5f: privacy classes L1/L2 (ADR-0018) — `init --privacy L1|L2 [--privacy-key-file <path>]` reads the recovery key from a hidden /dev/tty (CONIN$) prompt, a key file or JAVI_PRIVACY_KEY (deleted from the environment at once; never argv), refuses a UUID project ref and --no-verify, sends the installation canary (L2 encrypted `{v:1,canary:true}`, L1 class only) through an in-memory spool before anything is written, then stores the key in the project's credentials entry (0600); `--privacy L0` removes it. In L1/L2 projects hooks add `x.javi.thread.identity` after `session.started` and the collector `heartbeat working` (keyed `cwd_hash`/`repo_hash`/`branch_hash`, L2 AES-256-GCM `{repo, branch}` with the collector-set event_id in the AAD); every other event stays L0. The session folder (payload `cwd`) is read for that event only: `.git`/HEAD as regular files of at most 1 KiB, one `gitdir:` level, no git spawned. Children get an env without the key; flush records rejection codes per project and `status` shows them with the class and kid.
provides: dist/javi.mjs bundle (pnpm build), javis-dog-javi tarball (pnpm pack:cli)
javi --platform <claude-code|gemini-cli|codex-cli> (init, uninstall, status, hook, usage on|off)
installMcpLauncher() / mcpLauncherScript() / mcpLauncherPath() / mcpEntry() / codexMcpBlock() / registrationPath()
